description: Use Playwright (Python) for all web scraping and page-fetching tasks instead of curl, wget, or requests. Trigger this skill whenever the task involves: fetching a web page's content, scraping data from a URL, reading a website's text, extracting information from HTML, or any task where a web page needs to be loaded and parsed. Playwright handles JavaScript-rendered pages, cookies, redirects, and anti-bot measures far better than curl. Do NOT use curl for fetching web page content — reserve curl exclusively for testing HTTP APIs (REST/GraphQL endpoints, checking status codes, headers, JSON responses).
